name: zkit
description: Matching decomps of GameCube and Switch games, and native ports built from them: zkit's own delinker, unit and class recovery and progress reports, plus agent evidence (lookup, callers, original asm and data, compiled-vs-original diffs, port planning, drift and test impact, handoffs).

interface.shortDescription: GameCube and Switch decomp and port toolkit
interface.longDescription: Local toolkit for matching decompilations of GameCube and Switch games and native ports built from them: its own delinker, unit and class recovery and progress reports, and a read-only index of the decomp, the original executable and the port for session briefs, lookup, disassembly, xrefs, port planning, drift and constant checks, test impact and handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Give me the zkit brief for this repo
